origin: KiCad schematics by the maintainer, exported for ngspice, and variants of them made for M14, each changing one form
author: xdylanm
notes: Linear dependent sources and switches for M14. A variant's second line says what it changes. The intentional failures are in elements_rejects. Provenance confirmed by the maintainer, 2026-11-06.

diag_f_ctrl_missing.cir.note: Loads with UNRESOLVED_ELEMENT: no source Vmissing.

solver.skip: ngspice 47 stops: unknown controlling source vmissing (decision 0015 item 4).

diag_w_ctrl_resistor.cir.note: Loads with CONTROL_SOURCE_MISMATCH: W's controlling source is a resistor.

solver.skip: ngspice 47 stops: unknown controlling source r6 (decision 0015 item 5).

test_cascade.cir.note: Variant: all six letters in one circuit; F, H and W sense one source.

test_esource.cir.note: E: a VCVS of gain 2.2 into a divider (KiCad).

test_esource_formula.cir.note: Variant: the gain is a formula.

test_fsource.cir.note: F: a CCCS sensing V1, gain {K} (KiCad).

test_fsource_m.cir.note: Variant: half the gain with m=2.

test_fsource_subckt.cir.note: Variant: F inside a subcircuit, controlled by a source of its own body.

test_gsource.cir.note: G: a VCCS between two dividers (KiCad).

test_gsource_m.cir.note: Variant: half the transconductance with m=2.

test_hsource_sense_later.cir.note: Variant: the controlling source is a 0 V sense source written after H.

test_iswitch.cir.note: W: a CSW switch sensing Vsense, swept with .dc (KiCad).

test_iswitch_off.cir.note: Variant: the initial state is OFF.

test_vswitch.cir.note: S: an SW switch with off, swept with .dc (KiCad).

test_vswitch_on.cir.note: Variant: the initial state is ON.
